lines.en: Excuse me. Dr. Bobby happens to be an excellent doctor.
Oh, wait a minute. His name is Dr. Bobby?
And, um, excuse me, he helps me.
What do you need help for?
With my alignment. I got one leg shorter than the other.
What? It's true. My right leg is 200 shorter.
So what do you let her go to a chiropractor for?
What can I do? She doesn't listen to me about, uh, about renter's insurance either.
Wait a minute. You don't have renter's insurance?
Well, what if somebody steals something?
How are you going to run after him with one leg shorter than the other?
Hey, would you, uh, would you like some juice?
Wow, this is going so well.
Did you see us? Did you see?
Yeah, honey, I'm standing right there.
Why don't you just tell me about the mall?
